$comment: Frozen behavior spec for the Python rewrite. Hand-extracted from the TypeScript reference at commit 69ffb4b; input schemas are machine-captured in ts-0.5.0-tools-list.json. Every value here must become a contract test (ADR-0001). Reference facts change only with a new reference freeze. Quirk dispositions and sanctioned divergences change with their ADR. Every known_reference_quirks entry cites file:line at 69ffb4b.
tools_list_order: registration order as above; tools/list snapshot: ts-0.5.0-tools-list.json
output_schemas: none — every tool returns one text content block containing JSON.stringify(payload, null, 2); see ADR-0006

numeric_tolerances.probability_sum_tolerance: 0.01 + 1e-12 (lib.ts:11 PROBABILITY_SUM_TOLERANCE). jev_extract uses <= 0.01 (index.ts:1060, quirk Q2, ADR-0012). A 0.99 sum is 0.010000000000000009 from 1 and is rejected only by extract.
numeric_tolerances.confidence: finite in [0,1] else treated as null (unknown)

caps.$comment: Lengths are JS string .length = UTF-16 code units (ADR-0005). 'reject' = zod schema rejects; 'truncate' = truncate(text, n) appends ' […truncated]'. Error caps are strict greater-than checks (e.g. '>8000 → error' means 8000 is allowed). null max = deliberately uncapped in the reference; do not add a bound.

jev_extract.candidate_chars: >2000 → skipped + counted as tooLong, never truncated

jev_gate.aggregate_evidence_chars: >200000 → isError result. The error text renders the cap with toLocaleString('en-US'), so the digits appear as 200,000 (index.ts:1397)
jev_gate.doc_chars: 50000 truncate each (request, diff, tests, evidence item)

defaults.policy_threshold_invariant: 0 <= review_at <= auto_accept <= 1 else throw 'Thresholds must satisfy 0 <= review_at <= auto_accept <= 1.'

policy.review_action: escalate if min_confidence null or < review_at or safe_to_apply < review_at; auto if safe_to_apply >= auto_accept and composite >= floor and min_confidence >= auto_accept; else review; then requireCompleteContext
policy.claim_action: escalate if confidence null or < review_at; escalate if contradicted and confidence >= auto_accept; auto if verified and confidence >= auto_accept; else review; then requireCompleteContext
policy.classification_decision: auto iff top_probability >= auto_accept AND margin >= minimum_margin
policy.margin: top1 - top2 of probability values; < 2 values → 0
policy.verify_action: auto iff confidence >= auto_accept; confidence null → review; no escalate tier
policy.screen: injection >= block_at → block; >= review_at → review; substance < 0.3 → skip; relevance < 0.3 → skip; else pass. Reason strings use toFixed(2).
policy.rank_candidates: descending probability, ties keep caller order; missing prob → 0

ids.sanitize: replace /[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/g with '_', strip leading/trailing '_', slice(0,64); empty → `${prefix}${index}`
duplicate_caller_ids_rejected_in: jev_classify (supplied item ids and supplied class ids; a generated fallback that equals a supplied id is quirk Q11, diverged in ADR-0031)

extract_regex_pipeline.dialect: ECMAScript, matched in UTF-16 code units (ADR-0004). Python maps each unit to one character via chr of each UTF-16-LE pair and maps match text back with surrogatepass.
extract_regex_pipeline.flags: Reference: strip non [a-z], append 'g', collapse repeated g (index.ts:992). Python also rejects u, y, d, v, s, m, and i when a literal or class endpoint is outside U+0000-U+007F (ADR-0004).
order: if 20 already kept: truncated = true, stop
extract_regex_pipeline.isolation: Reference: fresh worker thread per field, hard terminate at 1000 ms; fields run sequentially (index.ts:918, index.ts:990-993). Python: process pool of size min(8, cpu count), one pattern per slot, kill and replace that slot on deadline; a full pool queues (ADR-0004).
extract_regex_pipeline.field_timing: Sequential caller order is kept (ADR-0012). Duration is not part of the tool output.
extract_regex_pipeline.timeout_error: regex timed out after 1000ms; simplify the pattern
extract_regex_pipeline.invalid_pattern_reason: Reference passes through V8 SyntaxError.message from the worker (index.ts:906-908). Python returns a named reason. Sanctioned divergence, ADR-0004. The timeout string above is shared.
extract_regex_pipeline.zero_api_call_case: no field has candidates → no provider call; usage null, provider 'none'

openrouter.slug: Rewrite jev-latest to jev-1.13 first (provider.ts:129-130). If the model already starts with typesafe/, use it verbatim; otherwise prefix typesafe/ (provider.ts:131).

cloudflare.unwrap: result.result ?? result ?? body. Error only when result.state is a string and not 'Completed' (provider.ts:251-253). A missing state is not an error.

compatible.envelope_validation: body object; answers object; usage absent|null or finite non-negative input_tokens+output_tokens; model absent|null|string

known_reference_quirks.$comment: Behaviors in the reference that look accidental. Each cites file:line at commit 69ffb4b and has a keep-or-diverge ADR. Q5 was withdrawn: jev_compare range-validates confidence in validateChoiceAnswer (index.ts:1192-1196); the ?? null at index.ts:860 is redundant (ADR-0012).
known_reference_quirks.Q1_envelope_validation_uneven: Only compatible validates the envelope (provider.ts:175-194); OpenRouter and Cloudflare coerce missing answers to {} (provider.ts:149, provider.ts:256) so tools emit per-item invalid_response. Python: diverge (ADR-0003). Source: provider.ts:149, provider.ts:175-194, provider.ts:256.
known_reference_quirks.Q2_extract_sum_tolerance: jev_extract inlines its own validation with sum tolerance 0.01 (no +1e-12) and no isRecord(probabilities) check; a 0.99 sum is 0.010000000000000009 from 1, so extract rejects it and validateChoiceAnswer accepts it. Python: keep (ADR-0012). Source: index.ts:1049-1060, lib.ts:11.
known_reference_quirks.Q3_decide_invalid_checks_silent: jev_decide records malformed requirement checks as answer invalid_response and keeps them in checks, and drops them from contradiction warnings. No top-level status or escalation. Python: keep (ADR-0012). Source: index.ts:639-670.
known_reference_quirks.Q4_verify_confidence_strictness: jev_verify invalidates a relation whose confidence is present but malformed; other tools coerce malformed confidence to null. Python: keep (ADR-0012). Source: index.ts:191-192.
known_reference_quirks.Q6_tofixed_rounding: Reason strings use Number.toFixed(2) (ties round half up on the exact binary value: 0.125 becomes 0.13); Python format rounds half-even (0.12). Python reproduces the JS rounding (ADR-0006). Source: lib.ts:79-85.
known_reference_quirks.Q7_number_serialization: JSON.stringify: integral floats print as ints (1.0 becomes 1); exponential notation only when exponent >= 21 or <= -7 (3.2e-5 becomes 0.000032, 1.5e-7 becomes 1.5e-7, 1e21 becomes 1e+21). Python json prints 1.0 and switches to exponential below 1e-4 with a zero-padded exponent (3.2e-05, 1.5e-07). Sub-1e-4 probabilities are routine in large Choice distributions. Python reproduces JS formatting (ADR-0006). Source: index.ts:86.
known_reference_quirks.Q8_utf16_truncation: truncate() slices UTF-16 code units and can split a surrogate pair, emitting a lone surrogate. Python drops the dangling unit on truncate only (ADR-0005). A one-unit regex match is kept and JSON-escaped (ADR-0004, ADR-0006). Source: lib.ts:47-49.
known_reference_quirks.Q9_cloudflare_error_unredacted: Cloudflare and OpenRouter error bodies are not passed through secret redaction. The reference redacts only JEV_API_KEY, and only on the compatible error body. Python redacts every configured secret (ADR-0008). Source: provider.ts:145-146, provider.ts:169-172, provider.ts:246-247.
known_reference_quirks.Q10_no_cancellation: index.ts askJev() never passes an AbortSignal, so MCP client cancellation does not abort the provider request even though provider.ts supports it. Python: diverge (ADR-0011). Source: index.ts:81-83, provider.ts:104.
known_reference_quirks.Q11_classify_omitted_id_collides: jev_classify assigns an omitted id `{kind}{index}` and does not check it against supplied ids, so an omitted item beside `{id: item0}` returns two results with id item0 and the class probabilities object keeps one key (recorded in duplicate-id/classify-omitted-ids-get-positional-fallbacks). Supplied duplicates are still rejected (index.ts:441, index.ts:450). jev_rerank checks its fallback (index.ts:711-722). Python: diverge, reject before any provider request (ADR-0031). Source: index.ts:398-526.

conditional_questions.jev_verify: source_{id} only when evidence has >1 item; its absence never invalidates relation_{id}
conditional_questions.jev_screen: relevance only when purpose is truthy; injection + substance always
conditional_questions.jev_decide: check_{i}_{j} only for supplied requirements; escape hatches only when escape_hatches=true
conditional_questions.jev_compare: aspect_{i} only for supplied aspects; overall always
conditional_questions.jev_extract: f{i} only for fields with ≥1 candidate and no pattern error; zero such fields → no provider call
conditional_questions.jev_gate: claim_{i} per claim plus the five review questions

not_captured.$comment: The manifest is necessary but not sufficient. These are specified only by the pinned source (commit 69ffb4b) and must be copied verbatim or recorded as parity fixtures.
items: question instruction strings and criteria maps for every tool
ANTI_INJECTION framing and gate claim framing text
output payload key names and key order for every tool (only gate/extract/verify/screen partially read)
error message strings thrown from tool handlers, including the jev_gate aggregate-budget error, which renders 200000 as 200,000 via toLocaleString('en-US') (index.ts:1397)
tool titles and descriptions (captured in ts-0.5.0-tools-list.json)

captured_by.$comment: Parity fixtures recorded from the pinned reference (tests/parity/, make parity-record). Each item above is fixed by the fixture data named here, not transcribed into this manifest.
captured_by.question_strings_and_criteria: calls[].exchanges[].request.body.questions in every fixture whose call reaches the provider; key order is significant
captured_by.anti_injection_and_gate_framing: request.body.questions of jev_review and jev_gate fixtures: tests/parity/fixtures/mock/025-jev-review-returns-auto-on-a-strong-patch-and-sends-anti-injection-framing.json, tests/parity/fixtures/mock/043-jev-gate-makes-one-request-keeps-injected-directives-in-state-and-frames-every-q.json
captured_by.output_key_names_and_order: calls[].result.content[0].text in every fixture; success and invalid_response branches of every tool are both covered (fixtures/index.json lists them by class)
